result.scope: One company's debt deductions for an income year starting on or after 1 July 2023 (2023-24 to 2026-27) under ITAA 1997 Subdivision 820-AA, from figures and classifications the operator has established. Nothing is disallowed for an entity Division 820 does not cover, a special purpose entity meeting s 820-39(3) throughout the year, an entity whose debt deductions with those of its associate entities are $2 million or less (s 820-35), or one that would be an outward investing financial entity (non-ADI) only and whose average Australian assets are at least 90% of its average total assets, associates' included (s 820-37). Otherwise, by the stated test: fixed ratio (no choice made), the amount by which net debt deductions (debt deductions less the assessable amounts in s 820-50(3)(b): interest, amounts in the nature of or economically equivalent to interest, amounts another entity incurred to obtain or keep the benefits of a debt interest and any prescribed expense; possibly negative) exceed 30% of tax EBITDA (ss 820-50(1)(a) and 820-51(1)); group ratio (a choice under s 820-46(3)), the excess over the group ratio times tax EBITDA, the group ratio being the GR group net third party interest expense over GR group EBITDA, each member's negative entity EBITDA disregarded (ss 820-51(2), 820-53 and 820-55); third party debt (a choice made or taken to be made under s 820-46(4) or (5)), the amount by which debt deductions exceed those attributable to debt interests satisfying the third party debt conditions (ss 820-50(1)(c) and 820-427A). Tax EBITDA is the stated taxable income or tax loss, earlier years' tax losses deducted (s 820-52(1A)), less franking credits, associate dividends and R&D notional deductions, plus net debt deductions, Division 40 and 43, forestry and s 70-120 deductions and any stated excess tax EBITDA amount, nil if negative (s 820-52); no regulation under s 820-52(1)(d) was in force when read.
